'''Faybos''' were [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]]-like scavenger creatures of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] found near [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] camps. They had large ears, long fangs and striped coat.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Faybos were initially intended to be guard animals at a Tusken Raider camp around a pond,<ref name="ArtoII" /> but eventually this role was given to [[Massiff/Legends|massiffs]].<ref name="DB-massiff">{{DB|creature|massiff|massiff}}</ref> They were designed by [[Ed Natividad]].<ref name="ArtoII" />
